title: Development and validation of a deep learning model for early detection and screening of diabetic retinopathy.
summary: Zero-shot text-image deep-learning model detects diabetic-retinopathy lesions across five internal/public test sets and an external smartphone set. The learned model operation and predictor inputs are described in the reviewed Methods. Testing: Full Methods/Results in NCBI PMC BioC; exact model and held-out/external evaluation reviewed..
